notes.title: 🌌 1.2.0 Part 1: The Galactic Update!
notes.notes:
Yo! After over two months, the first part of the 1.2 update is launching today! Controller & Steam Deck support are also ready, but they're waiting on an engine bug that's due to be fixed in around a week from now. Let's talk about what's now available in 1.2 part 1! :)

Level Select Overhaul
The album select for the game has been replaced with an expandable galaxy map, with its own adaptive music (courtesy of boxlion) and a nonlinear progression path. 

This way, it's a lot easier to tell where files lead to, and you don't feel pressured to try the difficult sweets album right out of the gate. Since the old album select was a badly sorted vertical list, this new one should ease you into the game in a smoother way, unless you really wanna challenge yourself and go for the hard albums first!

Albums in the game have also been given subtle background improvements with floating background elements when inside them!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45057857/a71b287412159e4fbdfdd3590583ec208dacf610.gif
Brand new map!

Upgraded Keybindings & UI
You can now change the keybinds for restarting and exiting files, as well as binding more keys. You can now map unorthodox keys like Ctrl, Shift, Tab, or Backspace to anything you want if you wish to!

The default keybindings for restarting and exiting files have also been changed to R and Esc respectively.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45057857/b74e1bdb8a8e874378a25cbdaf5d6467a498ef8f.gif

The UI for the settings menu has also been improved, with some flavor elements and iconography!

Better Startup Screen
The game has a new and improved startup screen that gets you into the game in around a third of the time it used to, by skipping past unnecessary cutscenes. It also looks better visually!

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45057857/84bb9c8b6748470f168f551c13a410d5698f3e1e.png

1.2 part 2?
Because of engine issues, the second half of 1.2, which will bring full controller & Steam Deck support, is going to be launched within the next half-week or so. Everything is ready, but we are currently just waiting on a hotfix for the engine. Thanks for being patient with us!

If you have anything to say about this update, good or bad, please provide feedback on our discord server or the Steam forums! Thank you so much!

-Encabulated Games

notes.title: Demo Update 1.2!
notes.notes:
⚡ Demo Update 1.2!
Yo! The demo has been updated to reflect the full version of the game. This update primarily translates most of the full version's features and polish onto the demo, which hasn't been updated in a couple months.

Changes
- Errors now have an "X" effect when they hit the "floor"
- The "parser" and "inputs" tabs are now present, just not able to be selected
- New calibration system that was featured in Full Version 1.1
- A new input to restart a song as it's currently playing, also reflected in the sidebar in-game
- Slightly adjusted slashing animations
- Redone storepage logos and images, as well as a new library logo
- Encabulated Games logo sound FX now reflect the sound FX set in settings (no more obliterated ears)
- Music and SFX start at 30% instead of 50%
- Engine version "Guava" that comes with some performance improvements

Bug Fixes
- The "/Main/(levelname)" UI/background element in the bottom left of the screen has had its text positioning fixed.
- Esc no longer toggles fullscreen

Thanks for playing! Cool stuff to share soon™ :)

-Encabulated Games

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Better calibration, input fixes & more!
notes.notes:
🔧Update 1.1 - Better calibration, input fixes & more!
Yo! Update 1.1 has arrived, and many features are thanks to YOUR feedback (thanks so much)! Let's go over some of the new stuff in this update.

Calibration changes
There is now a brand new calibration screen with tons of changes and fixes to make calibrating easier!

The diamond in the center has been replaced with a "bars on a line" style that should make understanding when to click a lot more intuitive. A metronome sound has also been added to the calibration song to make it easier to tell when to click.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45057857/ab41270bdf10b8a39d552dceedece2e87287a956.png

There has also been a lot of elaboration in text form, as well as a couple alerts for common mistakes to help make sure you get the intended gameplay experience.

There are also new buttons to adjust the delay manually if you'd rather do that instead of try clicking to the music!

Finally, you no longer need to calibrate to play the game. Most players never needed to utilize calibration in the first place, so now it's just an option instead of something you need to do to start the game.

Other notable changes
- Esc can now be set as a keybinded key
- The startup animation sound volume is now determined by the SFX setting
- Starting volume changed from 50% to 30%
- Game now starts in fullscreen
- Bugfix: Esc no longer toggles fullscreen while ingame (unless set to do so)
- Bugfix: Certain letter keys properly work with the keybinding system

Thanks for enjoying the game so far! More to come soon :)

-Encabulated Games

notes.title: Mac Version Out Now!
notes.notes:
🍎 The MacOS Version is Out Now!

Yo!

The MacOS Version has just released! It had to be delayed for a bit because of some bugs, but they were fixed and now the game has been tested and is ready for those who want to enjoy it on their Apple computers.

What next?

Apologies for the relative radio silence since release - the game release happened to be the same time I moved back to college, so I've been busy moving in, getting re-adjusted, and boiling in a room that isn't, but really should be air conditioned.

However, I want to thank you all for the good launch so far! The game still has yet to hit the magic 10 reviews, but it's been covered by people on youtube and got a lot of attention on Steam.

There have been some interesting things happening with the release, and a lot of player suggestions, such as controller support, mouse locking and a level editor have been looked into. We are going to continue development of the game, and we will talk about the details of it in Sunday Devlog 15 this weekend.

Anyway - thanks for following the game through release! Can't wait to cook even more up in the coming weeks, and maybe even let everyone else into the kitchen, too.. Till then!

-Encabulated Games

notes.title: Demo update 1.1!
notes.notes:
⚡ Demo update 1.1

Demo update 1.1 has arrived! This new update comes with a few cool things and will be the last major update for the demo prior to release. Let's talk about it!

New score saving system!

The new score saving system looks better and saves percentages in addition to scores!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45057857/5141c4b1fe844e09c2797fa5f6aebe48c97bc276.png

Calibration!

Before playing, you now need to calibrate the game. This lets the game take into account your audio delay and should allow everyone to play the game properly. Delay was a plague to a few people, so I'm glad this feature is now out!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45057857/b4106dc4e3bba59b0a3a410008ccb48f92e773ce.png

New slash effects!

An extra "star" effect now shows up when you slash errors. This effect makes slashing feel a lot "sharper" and while it was a pretty quick and easy thing to implement, it definitely helps with the look of the game!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45057857/69f55faa05477fbc86f983f2910429aec4ae1937.gif

Save resetting!

You can now reset your saves. In order to prevent accidents, you need to unlock the button with "O", then hold the button down, and THEN press "P". Hopefully this will be secure enough that nobody accidentally does it.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45057857/dfb7bf05ac8ebea515559ce7ecb4c3a76f0ad3dc.gif

Other changes!

The following bugs have been eradicated:

- At low speeds, the background would appear jittery and un-smooth
- If your mouse was at the top of the screen, clicks wouldn't be registered

Also, the game icon has now been updated for the demo and full version!

Noted issues

The new engine version has introduced brief flashes during transitions between levels. Once this is fixed, an announcement will be made and the game will be updated!

Thanks for enjoying the game!

Let us know if you have any issues or requests on the discord server!

-Encabulated Games
